caption: Original artwork for the Rookframe MÖRK BORG implementation; not official publisher artwork.
prompt: Wide landscape 3:2 original dark fantasy RPG illustration. Acid yellow field, rough black ink medieval skeleton crowned with broken antlers on right, torn-paper collage and irreverent punk zine screenprint texture, small slash of hot magenta, angular ruined cathedral silhouettes at bottom. Provocative graphic art, heavy contrast, NOT a reproduction of an existing book cover. Flat full bleed artwork only, no text, no lettering, no logos or UI. An original illustrative media fixture for a MÖRK BORG implementation product page; no claim of official publisher artwork.
note: Existing Rookframe mockup artwork reused unchanged for this implementation. No claim of official MÖRK BORG publisher artwork.
